error.SUMMARY_INVALID: summary must be one non-empty line of at most {maxLength} characters.
error.ROLE_INVALID: role must be one non-empty line of at most {maxLength} characters.
error.CLAIM_LIMIT_RANGE: The claim limits are out of range.
error.CLAIM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The first pending message does not fit the claim limits.
error.VALIDATION_FAILED: The input does not satisfy the constraints its contract declares.
error.CONCURRENT_UPDATE: Another change to the same data happened at the same time; repeat the call.
error.NATIVE_WAKE_CLAIM_CHANGED: The wake reservation changed while its messages were being claimed. This claim had no effect.
error.CURRENT_GENERATION_PROTECTED: Another process owns the current generation of this session.
error.GENERATION_CHANGED: The expected generation is not the current one.
error.GENERATION_STALE: This start is older than the current generation of the session.
error.STORE_CONFLICT: Another call changed the session first.
error.GATE_FAILED: A rule of the product refuses this step now.
error.BINDING_REQUIRED: This call needs the session it belongs to, and it does not say which one it is.
error.BINDING_INVALID: The session this call names is not valid.
error.PEER_MAIN_SESSION_REQUIRED: PEER connects distinct main sessions. Use host messaging tools to report to your parent.
error.REFERENCE_VIOLATION: The data refers to something that does not exist, or to something that other data still refers to.
error.VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED: The store does not allow this value.
error.RECAP_INVALID: recap must be a summary that is not blank and weighs at most 500: 5 for each Korean, Chinese or Japanese character and 2 for any other (100 Korean or 250 other characters).
error.PROMPT_NOT_ARCHIVED: This session has no user prompt in the archive yet, so there is nothing for a recap to belong to.
error.PROMPT_SESSION_UNHOOKED: This session is not one the hooks observe, so none of its prompts is archived. Call with the session reference of a session the host started.
error.ROLE_NOT_BOUND: scope ROLE needs this session to be bound to a role by the user. Recall with scope SESSION, or leave a request with bind_session_role and tell the user.
error.RECAP_NOT_ROOT: Only the main agent records the turn recap: it is the main agent''s summary of the turn, not a subagent''s own report. Report your result to the main agent and leave the recap to it.
error.PROMPT_NOT_FOUND: No user message has this promptId. Use a promptId that recall_user_prompts returned.
error.PROMPT_RANGE_INVALID: The time range is empty or out of bounds: from is inclusive and to is exclusive, so from must be earlier than to, and both must be later than 0001-01-01T00:00:00.000Z (received from={from}, to={to}).
error.PROMPT_TIME_UNREADABLE: from and to must be UTC times that exist, written like 2026-11-16T09:30:00.000Z (received from={from}, to={to}).
error.TRANSCRIPT_OTHER_SESSION: This message was said in another session. The transcript behind a message can be read only by the session that received it.
error.TRANSCRIPT_AFTER_NOT_IN_TURN: after is not an entry of this message''s turn. Use the key of an entry that an earlier answer for this promptId returned.
error.ADMIN_CHANGE_INVALID: The signed change is not one of the kinds the admin page signs, does not have the shape of its kind, or is too large.
error.ADMIN_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The signature of the change does not verify.
error.ADMIN_ALGORITHM_UNSUPPORTED: The signature algorithm of the key is not supported.
error.WEBAUTHN_PUBLIC_KEY_UNAVAILABLE: The public key of the passkey could not be read.
error.ADMIN_CHALLENGE_MISMATCH: The challenge in the signed data is not the one issued for this change.
error.ADMIN_RPID_MISMATCH: The relying party in the signed data is not this server.
error.ADMIN_USER_VERIFICATION_MISSING: The passkey did not verify the user.
error.ADMIN_INTENT_BEFORE_START: The signed intent was prepared before this server started.
error.ADMIN_INTENT_NOT_ISSUED: The signed intent was not prepared by this server, or it has already been used.
error.ADMIN_INTENT_NONCANONICAL: The signed intent is not in its canonical form.
error.ADMIN_RECORD_ALTERED: A record of the admin log was altered after it was signed.
error.ADMIN_ORIGIN_REJECTED: The change was signed for another origin than this server''s.
error.ADMIN_KEY_NOT_REGISTERED: No key is registered to sign changes.
error.ADMIN_KEY_UNKNOWN: The key that signed the change is not registered.
error.ADMIN_KEY_REVOKED: The key that signed the change has been revoked.
error.ADMIN_TARGET_STALE: The target changed after the change was prepared; prepare it again.
error.ADMIN_ALREADY_BOOTSTRAPPED: The first key is already registered.
error.ADMIN_LAST_KEY_REVOKE_REFUSED: The last active key cannot be revoked.
error.ADMIN_LOG_REGRESSED: The admin log of the target is behind a record that was seen before.
error.BUSINESS_DATABASE_NOT_H2: H2 is used only for the first-time settings of Sennard and cannot be linked as the business database. Link another database.
error.ARTIFACT_OPERATION_CONFLICT: This operationKey already began an upload with other content.
error.ARTIFACT_CHUNK_CONFLICT: The chunk is out of order, or its number was already received with other content.
error.ARTIFACT_BUSY: Another request for the same upload is in progress: an append, or a begin with the same operationKey. Send the request again later.
error.ARTIFACT_INCOMPLETE: The upload has a tail that is not yet taken in, or fewer bytes than it declared. Send the missing chunks.
error.ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH: The sha256 or the size the upload declared is not that of the bytes received.
error.ARTIFACT_CORRUPTED: The stored file fails its tag, hash, size or end mark.
error.CHUNK_HASH_MISMATCH: The sha256 of the chunk is not the one declared.
error.ARTIFACT_NOT_FOUND: No upload or attachment has this id.
error.ARTIFACT_UNSUPPORTED_PURPOSE: This product keeps only uploads of the purpose evidence.
error.ARTIFACT_LIMIT: A limit of the attachment storage is exceeded: {limit}.
error.ARTIFACT_STORAGE_FULL: The disk does not have the space this file needs; the owner has to free disk space.
error.ARTIFACT_STORAGE_IO_ERROR: The attachment storage could not be read or written.
error.ARTIFACT_STORAGE_UNSAFE: A path of the attachment storage cannot be used: it is not a regular file or folder (a file where a folder belongs, and the like), or the file system cannot make it private to its owner.
error.ARTIFACT_KEY_MISSING: There is no usable key for the key this file was written with: its key file is missing, empty, or not 256 bits.
